description:
Approved by the user 2026-11-17 (relayed by Bugs and Cleanup, verbatim "3. yes.").

From #720's missed page prediction (bench, release, instructions over control): of the +47 instructions a tail try still costs, ~20 are the generic capture-0 store (store_ref_word) in fill_cont_captures. Every continuation fill pays it. Specializing the store to the capture's statically known kind takes it from ~20 to ~3 instructions.

Concordant work, agree the seam before building: Callables' continuation-cost page (https://claude.ai/artifact/BvwfPpc9Q9kGxcJCG4S2zK, /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-9x7-cheap-continuations.html) step B, "static capture kinds, static frame size" (pending the user), covers the same stores; fz-9x7.37 (allocation statistics leave the inline path) edits the same place_cont_closure / alloc path in native_codegen/closure.rs. This ticket is the capture-kind store; it should become step B's first piece, not a second implementation.

Signal: bench instructions per continuation fill on the tail-try probe (#720's), and the distiller; three paths agree; no pin rises.

comments.text: Seam agreed 2026-11-17 (B&C with Callables): .39 builds a capture-kind hook in CaptureStores plus the capture-0 CLOSURE arm, slot image identical to the generic store; continuation step B (Callables) adds the type-derived arm and the resume side.

title: A continuation's capture slots are filled by stores specialized to each capture's kind
